summary.text: Bill Lieske is a Republican state senator from Lonsdale, Minnesota, who represents District 58 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Mark Legvold.
He is a chiropractor by profession.

paragraphs.text: Lieske was born in Mankato, Minnesota, and lives in Lonsdale. He earned a doctor of chiropractic degree from Northwestern Health Sciences University, and his career experience includes working as a chiropractor.
Lieske won the Republican primary for the open District 58 seat in 2022, defeating Jake Cordes, and then won the general election over Clarice Grabau with 52.8 percent of the vote.
He took office on January 3, 2023, and his committee assignments for 2025-2026 are Health and Human Services Finance and Policy and Labor and Industry Policy.
